name: rules-construction-pds-cap
description: Rules audit (deliberate improvement over the original): a planet holds at most 2 PDS (unless Homeland Defense Act) and 1 space dock. The original placed a 3rd PDS through Construction and only warned afterwards. Naalu (pbd105) already has 2 PDS on Maaluuk (2 PDS added in setup); Construction primary 'Place 1 PDS' on that planet must be refused (engine: ConstructionPlaceKind.validate; bot: ButtonHelperModifyUnits.genericPlaceUnit ~construction).
